column4: SEC-REVIEW-ROWS-1 (2026-10-30, main 89ccadf57): a source-to-docs generator, not runtime code. The library behind cmd/statemapgen (main-wiring), which regenerates docs/state-map/*.tsv: a go/parser AST extractor over the router, proto, scheduler, cobra and MCP registration sites plus a 1-hop write-verb classifier (statemap.go, classify.go, overrides.go). It only reads .go sources and returns values (the generator command does the writing), holds no credentials, makes no network or DB calls and makes no authorization decision: its CLASS column only steers human review, and its under-count blind spot is named in the package doc. go list -deps of ./server, ./cmd/keyorix-mcp and ./cmd/keyorix-k8s-sync contains no internal/statemap, so no shipped binary links it. Its *_test.go files are repo-wide CI guards (completeness, generated drift, INVARIANTS.d fragments, t.TempDir cleanup, time.Local). Same standing as internal/faultstorage/gen.
